title: Shadowing Without Bounded Distortion
exact_claim: For every real 1 <= p < infinity, every bounded invertible composition operator on a sigma-finite dissipative system with a finite positive wandering generator has two-sided shadowing if and only if it is generalized hyperbolic, over real or complex scalars, without bounded distortion.
companion_question: The old aggregate-level-mass criterion does not extend; already refuted by Bernardes--D'Aniello--Maiuriello, arXiv:2607.15831v1, Example 6.2.
known_slice: Separable complex p=2 case is prior art through Pituk, arXiv:2608.19499v1, Theorem B.
historical_priority: Not established; no full prior theorem found in bounded source search.
